title: CVE-2023-34192: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) Vulnerability
summary: Synacor Zimbra Collaboration Suite (ZCS) contains a cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to execute arbitrary code via a crafted script to the /h/autoSaveDraft function.

title: CVE-2024-49035: Microsoft Partner Center Improper Access Control Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Partner Center contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows an attacker to escalate privileges.

title: CVE-2024-20953: Oracle Agile Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) Deserialization Vulnerability
summary: Oracle Agile Product Lifecycle Management (PLM) contains a deserialization vulnerability that allows a low-privileged attacker with network access via HTTP to compromise the system.

title: CVE-2017-3066: Adobe ColdFusion Deserialization Vulnerability
summary: Adobe ColdFusion contains a deserialization vulnerability in the Apache BlazeDS library that allows for arbitrary code execution.

title: CVE-2025-24989: Microsoft Power Pages Improper Access Control Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Power Pages contains an improper access control vulnerability that allows an unauthorized attacker to elevate privileges over a network potentially bypassing the user registration control.

title: CVE-2025-0111: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS File Read Vulnerability
summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an external control of file name or path vulnerability. Successful exploitation enables an authenticated attacker with network access to the management web interface to read files on the PAN-OS filesystem that are readable by the “nobody” user.

title: CVE-2025-23209: Craft CMS Code Injection Vulnerability
summary: Craft CMS contains a code injection vulnerability caused by improper validation of the database backup path, ultimately enabling remote code execution.

title: CVE-2025-0108: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS Authentication Bypass Vulnerability
summary: Palo Alto Networks PAN-OS contains an authentication bypass vulnerability in its management web interface. This vulnerability allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to the management web interface to bypass the authentication normally required and invoke certain PHP scripts.

title: CVE-2024-53704: SonicWall SonicOS SSLVPN Improper Authentication Vulnerability
summary: SonicWall SonicOS contains an improper authentication vulnerability in the SSLVPN authentication mechanism that allows a remote attacker to bypass authentication.

title: CVE-2024-57727: SimpleHelp Path Traversal Vulnerability
summary: SimpleHelp remote support software contains multiple path traversal vulnerabilities that allow unauthenticated remote attackers to download arbitrary files from the SimpleHelp host via crafted HTTP requests. These files may include server configuration files and hashed user passwords.

title: CVE-2025-24200: Apple iOS and iPadOS Incorrect Authorization Vulnerability
summary: Apple iOS and iPadOS contains an incorrect authorization vulnerability that allows a physical attacker to disable USB Restricted Mode on a locked device.

title: CVE-2024-41710: Mitel SIP Phones Argument Injection Vulnerability
summary: Mitel 6800 Series, 6900 Series, and 6900w Series SIP Phones, including the 6970 Conference Unit, contain an argument injection vulnerability due to insufficient parameter sanitization during the boot process. Successful exploitation may allow an attacker to execute arbitrary commands within the cont

title: CVE-2024-40891: Zyxel DSL CPE OS Command Injection Vulnerability
summary: Multiple Zyxel DSL CPE devices contain a post-authentication command injection vulnerability in the management commands that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute OS commands via Telnet.

title: CVE-2024-40890: Zyxel DSL CPE OS Command Injection Vulnerability
summary: Multiple Zyxel DSL CPE devices contain a post-authentication command injection vulnerability in the CGI program that could allow an authenticated attacker to execute OS commands via a crafted HTTP request.

title: CVE-2025-21418: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock Heap-Based Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Windows Ancillary Function Driver for WinSock contains a heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for privilege escalation, enabling a local attacker to gain SYSTEM privileges.

title: CVE-2025-21391: Microsoft Windows Storage Link Following Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Windows Storage contains a link following vulnerability that could allow for privilege escalation. This vulnerability could allow an attacker to delete data including data that results in the service being unavailable.

title: CVE-2025-0994: Trimble Cityworks Deserialization Vulnerability
summary: Trimble Cityworks contains a deserialization vulnerability. This could allow an authenticated user to perform a remote code execution attack against a customer's Microsoft Internet Information Services (IIS) web server.

title: CVE-2020-15069: Sophos XG Firewall Buffer Overflow Vulnerability
summary: Sophos XG Firewall contains a buffer overflow vulnerability that allows for remote code execution via the "HTTP/S bookmark" feature.

title: CVE-2020-29574: CyberoamOS (CROS) SQL Injection Vulnerability
summary: CyberoamOS (CROS) contains a SQL injection vulnerability in the WebAdmin that allows an unauthenticated attacker to execute arbitrary SQL statements remotely.

title: CVE-2024-21413: Microsoft Outlook Improper Input Validation Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft Outlook contains an improper input validation vulnerability that allows for remote code execution. Successful exploitation of this vulnerability would allow an attacker to bypass the Office Protected View and open in editing mode rather than protected mode.

title: CVE-2022-23748: Dante Discovery Process Control Vulnerability
summary: Dante Discovery contains a process control vulnerability in mDNSResponder.exe that all allows for a DLL sideloading attack. A local attacker can leverage this vulnerability in the Dante Application Library to execute arbitrary code.

title: CVE-2025-0411: 7-Zip Mark of the Web Bypass Vulnerability
summary: 7-Zip contains a protection mechanism failure vulnerability that allows remote attackers to bypass the Mark-of-the-Web security feature to execute arbitrary code in the context of the current user.

title: CVE-2024-53104: Linux Kernel Out-of-Bounds Write Vulnerability
summary: Linux kernel contains an out-of-bounds write vulnerability in the uvc_parse_streaming component of the USB Video Class (UVC) driver that could allow for physical escalation of privilege.

title: CVE-2018-19410: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor Local File Inclusion Vulnerability
summary: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor contains a local file inclusion vulnerability that allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to create users with read-write privileges (including administrator).

title: CVE-2018-9276: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor OS Command Injection Vulnerability
summary: Paessler PRTG Network Monitor contains an OS command injection vulnerability that allows an attacker with administrative privileges to execute commands via the PRTG System Administrator web console.

title: CVE-2024-29059: Microsoft .NET Framework Information Disclosure Vulnerability
summary: Microsoft .NET Framework contains an information disclosure vulnerability that exposes the ObjRef URI to an attacker, ultimately enabling remote code execution.

title: CVE-2024-45195: Apache OFBiz Forced Browsing Vulnerability
summary: Apache OFBiz contains a forced browsing vulnerability that allows a remote attacker to obtain unauthorized access.

title: Supreme Court: Waetzig v. Halliburton Energy Services, Inc.
summary: A case voluntarily dismissed without prejudice under Federal Rule of Civil Procedure 41(a) counts as a “final proceeding” under Rule 60(b). (No. 23-971, opinion by Justice Alito; 604 U.S. 305).

title: Supreme Court: Glossip v. Oklahoma
summary: The Court has jurisdiction to review the judgment of the Oklahoma Court of Criminal Appeals; the prosecution violated its constitutional obligation to correct false testimony under Napue v. Illinois, 360 U. S. 264. (No. 22-7466, opinion by Justice Sotomayor; 604 U.S. 226).

title: Supreme Court: Lackey v. Stinnie
summary: Plaintiffs who gained only preliminary injunctive relief before this action became moot do not qualify as “prevailing part[ies]” eligible for attorney’s fees under 42 U. S. C. §1988(b) because no court conclusively resolved their claims by granting enduring relief on the merits that altered the legal relationship between the parties. (No. 23-621, opinion by Chief Justice Roberts; 604 U.S. 192).

title: Supreme Court: Williams v. Reed
summary: Where a state court’s application of a state exhaustion requirement in effect immunizes state officials from 42 U. S. C. §1983 claims challenging delays in the administrative process, state courts may not deny those claims on failure-to-exhaust grounds. (No. 23-191, opinion by Justice Kavanaugh; 604 U.S. 168).

title: Supreme Court: Wisconsin Bell, Inc. v. United States ex rel. Heath
summary: The E-Rate reimbursement requests at issue are “claims” under the False Claims Act because the Government “provided” (at a minimum) a “portion” of the money applied for by transferring more than $100 million from the Treasury into the Fund. 31 U. S. C. §3729(b)(2)(A)(ii)(I). (No. 23-1127, opinion by Justice Kagan; 604 U.S. 140).

title: Supreme Court: Hungary v. Simon
summary: An allegation that a foreign sovereign liquidated expropriated property, commingled the proceeds with other funds, and then used some of those commingled funds for commercial activities in the United States cannot alone satisfy the commercial nexus requirement of the expropriation exception in the Foreign Sovereign Immunities Act of 1976. (No. 23-867, opinion by Justice Sotomayor; 604 U.S. 115).

title: New Flyer of America, Inc.: Fuel Filter Hoses May Disconnect and Leak Fuel (210 affected)
summary: New Flyer of America, Inc. (New Flyer) is recalling certain 2023-2024 XDE60, 2024 XD35, XD40, and XD60 transit buses equipped with Cummins L9 diesel engines.  The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.

title: Temsa: Fuel Filter Hoses May Disconnect and Leak Fuel (10 affected)
summary: Temsa is recalling certain 2024 TS35 vehicles equipped with Cummins L9 diesel engines.  The remote fuel filter hoses may separate from the fitting, causing a fuel leak and an engine stall.

title: Highland Ridge RV: Incorrect Tire Size on Certification Label (89 affected)
summary: Highland Ridge RV (Highland Ridge) is recalling certain 2025 Highland Ridge Open Range 3X fifth-wheel travel trailers.  The tire size listed on the vehicle certification label is incorrect.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of 49 CFR Part 567, "Certification."

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Third-Row Seat Belt May Not Function/FMVSS 208 (1,494 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2025 Honda Pilot vehicles.  The third-row passenger seat belt assembly may not function, due to incorrect routing that traps the seat belt behind the passenger side panel.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Samsung SDI Co., Ltd.: High Voltage Battery May Fail and Cause Fire (180,196 affected)
summary: Samsung SDI Co., Ltd. (Samsung SDI) is recalling certain high voltage battery packs, installed in certain Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) vehicles (NHTSA recalls 24V-720 and 24E-080), Volkswagen/Audi vehicles (NHTSA recall 24V-898) and Ford vehicles (NHTSA recall 24V-954).  Please see the attached document for a list of affected part numbers.  The high voltage batteries may fail.

title: Vantage Mobility: Insufficient Welds On Trailing Arm Mounts Can Fail (644 affected)
summary: Vantage Mobility, LLC (VM) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Toyota Sienna vehicles, equipped with a rear entry wheelchair conversion.  The trailing arm mounts have insufficient welds that can crack and fail.

title: General Motors, LLC: Chrome Front Grille Deflector May Detach (70,768 affected)
summary: General Motors, LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2022 GMC Sierra 1500 vehicles equipped with chrome front grille deflectors.  The attachments that hold the front grille deflectors in place may fracture, resulting in grille detachment.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Damaged Second-Row Seat Belt/FMVSS 209 (40,922 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2025 Toyota Camry Hybrid, Lexus NX250, NX350, NX350 Hybrid, 2024-2025 Lexus RX350, RX350 Hybrid, and RX500 Hybrid vehicles.  The second-row center seat belt webbing may be damaged.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 209, "Seat Belt Assemblies."

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Rear Brake Hose May Leak (221,846 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Tacoma 4-wheel drive vehicles.  The rear brake hoses can be damaged if mud and dirt builds up inside the rear wheels.  This can result in a brake fluid leak.

title: Hino Motors Sales U.S.A., Inc.: Front Right Air Brake Tube Can Be Damaged and Leak (19,026 affected)
summary: Hino Motors Sales U.S.A., Inc. (Hino) is recalling certain 2022-2025 NH7A, NJ7A, NJ7B, NJ7C, NV7A, NV7B, and NV7C trucks.  Contact with the fender can damage the front right brake tube and cause a leak.

title: Firefly Integrations, LLC: Awning Can Be Extended While The Vehicle Is Moving (13 affected)
summary: Firefly Integrations, LLC (Firefly) is recalling certain model G12 Multiplex Electronic Control Module (ECM) units, part number 130010113A, installed in Thor Motor Coach vehicles with a 38XL floor plan.  A software error prevents the awning control from being locked in certain situations as intended.

title: ZEEKR TECHNOLOGY US, LLC: TPMS Warning Light Malfunction/FMVSS 138 (1 affected)
summary: Zeekr Technology US, LLC (Zeekr) is recalling one 2025 RT vehicle.  The digital tire pressure monitoring system (TPMS) warning light may not flash long enough for the driver to notice.  Additionally, the owner's manual may be missing information about the TPMS warning light.  As such, this vehicle fails to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 138, "Tire Pressure Monitoring Systems."

title: Hyundai Motor America: Rear Side Air Bag May Not Deploy (33 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025 IONIQ 5 EV vehicles.  The rear floor wiring harness may contain an open circuit, which can result in the rear side air bag not deploying as intended.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Reduced Braking Performance from Software Error (1,587 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain 2025 Hyundai IONIQ 5 "N" vehicles equipped with a left-foot braking (LFB) feature.  The integrated electronic brake (IEB) and vehicle control unit (VCU) software may cause reduced braking performance when LFB is activated.

title: KTM North America, Inc.: Front Brake Caliper May Crack And Break (5,116 affected)
summary: KTM North America, Inc. (KTM) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Husqvarna FE 350s, FE 501s, and 2024-2025 GASGAS ES 350 and ES 500 motorcycles.  The front brake caliper may crack in the area around the upper guide pin.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrectly Installed Cargo System Can Detach (156 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Rockport work trucks.  The incorrect fasteners may have been used to install the optional E-Track Cargo Tie Down system.

title: Grand Design RV, LLC: Interior Step Tread Can Break (21,982 affected)
summary: Grand Design RV, LLC (Grand Design) is recalling certain 2019-2024 Grand Design Solitude fifth wheel trailers.  The step tread joints may be unsupported, causing the tread to break.

title: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC: High Voltage Battery May Catch Fire (12,236 affected)
summary: Mercedes-Benz USA, LLC (MBUSA) is recalling certain 2022-2025 EQB 250, EQB 300 4MATIC, and EQB 350 4MATIC electric vehicles.  The high voltage battery may fail internally and lead to a vehicle fire while parked or driving.

title: ZEEKR TECHNOLOGY US, LLC: Side Air Bag May Deploy Improperly/FMVSS 226 (1 affected)
summary: Zeekr Technology US, LLC (Zeekr) is recalling one 2025 RT vehicle.  The C-Pillar trim may catch the side curtain air bag, preventing the air bag from fully deploying.  As such, this vehicle fails to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 226, "Ejection Mitigation."

title: ZEEKR TECHNOLOGY US, LLC: Passenger Air Bag May Be Disabled/FMVSS 208 (1 affected)
summary: Zeekr Technology US, LLC (Zeekr) is recalling one 2025 RT vehicle.  The Occupant Weight Sensor (OWS) may misclassify the front passenger seat occupant or disable the air bag.  As such, this vehicle fails to comply with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: ZEEKR TECHNOLOGY US, LLC: Air Bags Provide Inadequate Protection/FMVSS 208 (1 affected)
summary: Zeekr Technology US, LLC (Zeekr) is recalling one 2025 RT vehicle.  The seat position may prevent the side curtain and passenger air bag from providing adequate neck protection during a crash.  As such, this vehicle fails to comply with Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) 208, "Occupant Crash Protection."

title: Storyteller Overland: Improperly Welded Seat Assembly/FMVSS 207 (120 affected)
summary: Storyteller Overland, LLC (Storyteller) is recalling certain 2024-2025 MODE XO vehicles.  The seat assembly's floor mounting system may be improperly welded, which can cause the seat assembly to loosen or detach.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 207, "Seating Systems."

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: Headlight Shutters May Close Unexpectedly (2,061 affected)
summary: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo) is recalling certain 2025 EX90 vehicles.  Due to a software error in the low power controller (LPC), the headlight shutters may close over the high and low beams while driving.

title: Jayco, Inc.: Water Tank Support Brackets May Damage Fuel Tank (1,106 affected)
summary: Jayco, Inc. (Jayco) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Entegra Coach Launch, 2022 Launch LE, 2021-2025 Jayco Terrain, and 2022 Terrain LE recreational vehicles.  The grey water tank support brackets may contact and damage the fuel tank, causing a leak.

title: Nikola Corporation: Mounting Bolts May Damage Hydrogen Tank (95 affected)
summary: Nikola Corporation (Nikola) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Tre FCEV trucks.  The hydrogen tank mounting block bolts may be too long and damage the tank.

title: Winnebago Industries, Inc.: Propane Tanks May Detach (696 affected)
summary: Winnebago Industries, Inc. (Winnebago) is recalling certain 2025 Minnie Winnie, Navion, Porto, Spirit, View, and Vita recreational vehicles.  The LP tank mounting bracket fasteners may have been improperly tightened, causing the tank to detach.

title: Gillig, LLC: Flat Panel Display Monitor May Detach from Ceiling (91 affected)
summary: Gillig, LLC (Gillig) is recalling certain 2019-2024 Low Floor transit buses.  The rivet-nut fasteners that secure the TFT flat panel display monitor to the bus ceiling may fail, causing the monitor to detach and fall.

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (29,569 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Tiguan, 2023 Arteon, and 2024-2025 Audi Q3 vehicles.  An error may occur in the camera control unit at vehicle startup, resulting in the rearview camera image not displaying as intended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: High-Voltage Battery May Overheat and Cause Fire (20,201 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2021-2024 Audi Q5, and 2022 A7 E Hybrid Electric PHEV vehicles.  The high-voltage battery may overheat.

title: Terberg Benschop B.V.: Steering Linkage Assembly Bolt May Loosen (33 affected)
summary: Terberg Benschop B.V. (Terberg Benschop) is recalling certain 2023-2024 YTXX3 vehicles.  A steering arm bolt may have been improperly tightened.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Rear Seat Belt Buckles Not Tightened Properly (279 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2023 911 vehicles.  The bolts for the rear seat belt buckles may not be tightened properly.

title: Porsche Cars North America, Inc.: Excessive Glare from Headlight Low Beams/FMVSS 108 (878 affected)
summary: Porsche Cars North America, Inc. (Porsche) is recalling certain 2025 911 vehicles.  A software error in the front-end electronics control module may result in the low beam headlights creating a glare for oncoming traffic.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Loss of Drive Power from Transmission Failure (19 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2025 Atlas and Atlas Cross Sport vehicles.  The transmission may have been manufactured incorrectly, which can result in a loss of drive power.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Left-Side Knee Air Bag May Deploy Improperly (1,270 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2020 Range Rover Evoque vehicles.  The cover for the left-side lower knee air bag may come loose, allowing the air bag cushion to unfold.

title: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC: Right-Side Knee Air Bag May Deploy Improperly (1,473 affected)
summary: Jaguar Land Rover North America, LLC (Land Rover) is recalling certain 2020 Range Rover Evoque vehicles.  The cover for the right-side lower knee air bag may come loose, allowing the air bag cushion to unfold.

title: Rivian Automotive, LLC: Headlight Low Beams May Fail/FMVSS 108 (17,260 affected)
summary: Rivian Automotive, LLC (Rivian) is recalling certain 2025 R1S and R1T vehicles.  The headlight low beams may fail to illuminate when starting the vehicle in cold weather.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (133 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain 2022 Jeep Grand Cherokee and 2021-2022 Jeep Grand Cherokee L vehicles.  The center stack upper display (DCSD) contains a transistor that may overheat and prevent the rearview camera image from displaying.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC): Rearview Image May Not Display/ FMVSS 111 (196 affected)
summary: Chrysler (FCA US, LLC) is recalling certain Mopar Center Stack UPR Displays with part numbers 68375145AG, 68375145AH, 68474166AG, and 68474166AH.  The display (DCSD) contains a transistor that may overheat and prevent the rearview camera image from displaying.  As such, this equipment fails to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Terex Advance Mixer, Inc.: Front Axle Shaft May Break (29 affected)
summary: Terex Advance Mixer, Inc. (Terex) is recalling certain 2024 Commander vehicles equipped with Meritor MX-23-810 axles.  The front axle may have an incorrect thrust bearing installed.

title: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing: Loose Third-Row Seatback Bolts/FMVSS 202 (167,802 affected)
summary: Toyota Motor Engineering & Manufacturing (Toyota) is recalling certain 2021-2025 Sienna Hybrid vehicles.  The bolts for the seatbacks on the third-row seat assemblies may not be tightened properly.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) numbers 202, "Head Restraints," 207, "Seating Systems," and 225, "Child Restraint Anchorage Systems."

title: General Motors, LLC: Driver's Door Impact Beam Improperly Welded (82 affected)
summary: General Motors LLC (GM) is recalling certain 2025 Chevrolet Express and GMC Savana vans.  The impact beam located in the driver's side door may have improper welds.

title: Columbus Trading-Partners USA, Inc.: Harness Strap May Detach From Seat (23,273 affected)
summary: Columbus Trading-Partners USA, Inc. (CTP) is recalling certain Cybex Aton G, Aton G SensorSafe, Aton G Swivel, Aton G Swivel SensorSafe, Eos and Aton G Swivel Travel System, Eos and Aton G Travel System, Libelle and Aton G Travel System, and Beezy and Aton G Travel System child seats.  The harness hip anchorage retention hooks may bend, causing the anchor pin to loosen, and the harness strap to detach.

title: Ford Motor Company: Tail Lights May Fail (2,711 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Maverick vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 24V-293.  The body control module (BCM) may inadvertently deactivate one or both rear tail lights.

title: Ford Motor Company: Missing Warning for Turn Signal Failure/FMVSS 108 (1,635 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Maverick vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 23V-848.  In the event that one of the rear turn signals stops working, the vehicle will not adjust the turn signal flash rate frequency to warn the driver that a turn signal has failed.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 108, "Lamps, Reflective Devices, and Associated Equipment."

title: Tesla, Inc.: Loss of Power Steering Assist (376,241 affected)
summary: Tesla, Inc. (Tesla) is recalling certain 2023 Model 3 and Model Y vehicles operating software prior to 2023.38.4.  The printed circuit board for the electronic power steering assist may experience an overstress condition, causing a loss of power steering assist when the vehicle reaches a stop and then accelerates again.

title: MORryde International, Inc.: Loose Axle Bearing Nut May Cause Tire To Detach (72 affected)
summary: MORryde International, Inc. (MORryde) is recalling certain IST22-008 suspensions installed on Grand Design Serenova travel trailers.  The axle bearing nut may have been improperly tightened, causing the bearings to overheat.

title: Ford Motor Company: Improperly Secured Seat Belt Buckle Anchor Bolts (240,510 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2020-2021 Explorer and Aviator vehicles.  The seat belt buckle anchor bolts at one or more seating positions may be improperly secured.  Additionally, vehicles may have an improperly secured seat belt retractor anchor bolt and/or seat belt anchor bolt at the second-row center seating position, if equipped.

title: Ford Motor Company: Exterior Mirror LED Lights May Cause Fire (35,328 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2015-2017 Lincoln Navigator vehicles.  The LED logo lights on the exterior mirrors may short circuit.

title: Daimler Vans USA, LLC: Loss of Drive Power (689 affected)
summary: Daimler Vans USA, LLC (DVUSA) is recalling certain 2024 Mercedes-Benz eSprinter vehicles.  The welds on the helical gear within the rear axle drivetrain may fail, causing a loss of drive power.

title: Ford Motor Company: Steering Wheel May Turn Unintentionally (332 affected)
summary: Ford Motor Company (Ford) is recalling certain 2022-2023 Ford Mustang vehicles previously repaired incorrectly under recall number 24V-493.  The secondary steering torque sensor may not be calibrated properly, which can cause the steering wheel to turn side to side against the driver's intentions.

title: Thor Motor Coach: Solar Panel May Detach While In Transit (637 affected)
summary: Thor Motor Coach (TMC) is recalling certain 2023 Gemini and Compass motorhomes.  Washers were not installed with the roof mounting brackets.

title: Nova Bus (US) Inc.: Insufficient Number of Emergency Exits/FMVSS 217 (2 affected)
summary: Nova Bus (US) Inc. (Nova Bus) is recalling certain 2006-2007 LFS transit buses. The buses may have been built with an incorrect number of emergency exits. As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 217, "Bus Emergency Exits and Window Retention and Release."

title: Kia America, Inc.: Engine Damage May Cause Stall or Fire (137,256 affected)
summary: Kia America, Inc. (Kia) is recalling certain 2021-2023 Seltos and Soul vehicles.  The piston oil rings may have been manufactured incorrectly, which can result in engine damage.

title: Maserati North America, Inc.: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (27,354 affected)
summary: Maserati North America, Inc. (Maserati) is recalling certain 2023-2024 Grecale, 2023-2025 MC20 Cielo, 2024 Granturismo, GranCabrio, 2021-2024 Levante, Ghibli, Quattroporte, and 2022-2025 MC 20 vehicles.  The radio software may prevent the rearview image from displaying.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Loose Engine Cover May Melt and Cause Fire (177,493 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Atlas and Atlas Cross Sport vehicles.  The engine cover may have been improperly installed after vehicle service, allowing it to come loose and contact hot engine surfaces.

title: Volvo Trucks North America: Delayed Brake Activation/FMVSS 121 (8 affected)
summary: Volvo Trucks North America (Volvo Trucks) is recalling certain 2023-2025 New VN trucks.  The brakes may take longer than expected to activate.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 121, "Air Brake Systems."

title: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc.: Rearview Camera Image May Not Display/FMVSS 111 (8,237 affected)
summary: Volkswagen Group of America, Inc. (Volkswagen) is recalling certain 2022-2024 Golf GTI vehicles.  A software error may delay or deactivate the rearview camera image, resulting in the rearview camera image not displaying as intended.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard number 111, "Rear Visibility."

title: Volvo Car USA, LLC: Improperly Secured Windows May Detach (15 affected)
summary: Volvo Car USA, LLC (Volvo) is recalling certain 2025 S90 vehicles.  The windows may be improperly secured and detach.

title: Indian Motorcycle Company: Fuel Pump May Fail (7 affected)
summary: Indian Motorcycle Company (Indian) is recalling certain 2025 Challenger Dark Horse, Pursuit Limited, Roadmaster Elite and Springfield Dark Horse motorcycles.  Due to an incorrectly crimped wire, the fuel pump may fail and result in an engine stall during operation.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Second-Row Side Door Lock Malfunction/FMVSS 206 (40,736 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2022-2024 X3 sDrive30i and X3 xDrive30i vehicles.  The second-row seat side door locking modules may not function properly and allow the doors to be unlocked with a single motion.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 206, "Door Locks and Door Retention Components."

title: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.): Gear Shift Arm May Detach (507 affected)
summary: Honda (American Honda Motor Co.) is recalling certain 2024 CB650R and CBR650R motorcycles.  The fasteners of the gear shift arm may loosen and detach, resulting in the inability to shift gears.

title: Hyundai Motor America: Instrument Panel Display Failure/FMVSS 101 (32,594 affected)
summary: Hyundai Motor America (Hyundai) is recalling certain Genesis 2023-2024 G80, GV80, 2025 GV70 and 2023-2025 GV70 "Electrified" vehicles.  Due to a software error, the instrument panel display may fail.  As such, these vehicles fail to comply with the requirements of Federal Motor Vehicle Safety Standard (FMVSS) number 101, "Controls and Displays."

title: Keystone RV Company: Side Window Incorrectly Labeled as Emergency Exit (100 affected)
summary: Keystone RV Company (Keystone) is recalling certain 2024-2025 Outback 330RL travel trailers.  The side window was incorrectly labeled as an emergency exit, which can delay passengers from exiting in the event of an emergency.

title: BMW of North America, LLC: Loose Cable Connection Between Battery and Starter (114 affected)
summary: BMW of North America, LLC (BMW) is recalling certain 2025 X3 30 xDrive vehicles.  The connection between the positive battery cable and the starter-generator may have been improperly tightened and overheat.

title: Forest River, Inc.: Incorrect Weight Rating on Placard/FMVSS 110 & 120 (1,833 affected)
summary: Forest River, Inc. (Forest River) is recalling certain 2017-2025 Coachmen Catalina, 2020-2025 Aurora, and 2025 Puma travel trailers.  The Gross Vehicle Weight Rating (GVWR) on the Federal placard may exceed the safety chain rating. However, despite these innovations, many LLMs continue to exhibit biases toward Western, Anglo-centric, or American cultures, with performance on English data consistently surpassing that of other languages.
